channel.title: Rafael Romão on Staff+ Engineering
channel.description: One essay a week on the work that starts where the job description ends.

item.title: Glue Work Is the Job, Until It Is Not
item.description: The connective labor that holds a project together is expected at Staff+ and career-limiting below it, and the difference is entirely whether anyone can see it.

item.title: Work Only You Can Do
item.description: Of everything worth doing this quarter, the only defensible filter is which work your particular position makes possible, and the test is whether the sentence still works with someone else's name in it.

item.title: The Job Nobody Writes Down
item.description: Staff+ is the first level where the organization states a need and you supply the job description, which is why two people with the same title can be doing different jobs and both be right.
